natalie (sec-eng): Heads-up — seeing a spike of TLS handshake errors from ap-south proxies since the cert rotation this morning. Lots of ClientHello with TLS1.2 and cipher fallback.
irfan (infra): Can you paste an example of the failure from proxy logs? sounds like a cipher-negotiation mismatch or old client.
sean (edge): We rolled the new intermediate chain at 07:10 UTC, right? Could be chain ordering.
natalie (sec-eng): Yep. rotation job finished 07:09. Here's a tail of the edge proxy error: 
```
2026-03-21T07:18:22Z ERROR tls_handshake.go:143 handshake failed: remote error: tls: unsupported protocol
2026-03-21T07:18:22Z INFO  conn 12345 client_hello: legacy_version=0x0303 ciphers=[TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256 TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256 ... TLS_RSA_WITH_AES_128_CBC_SHA]
```
irfan (infra): That looks like some legacy clients offering RSA-only ciphers and the proxy refusing RSA suites. Can you run an openssl probe from one of the failing hosts? `openssl s_client -connect edge-ap-south-01.redwood.internal:443 -tls1_2 -cipher 'AES128-SHA' -brief`
natalie (sec-eng): Ran it from a test host, output: 
```
CONNECTED(00000003)
139834... peer cert: /CN=edge-ap-south
---
SSL handshake has read 0 bytes and written 233 bytes
---
session ticket: not offered
---
no shared cipher
```
sean (edge): So the server isn't accepting that cipher. We intentionally removed RSA-AES-CBC suites to harden against CRC/CBC issues. But rolling that change without a soft-fallback probably broke a small set of legacy clients in ap-south.
opsbot: incident created: #INC-2026-4832 — label=low-availability region=ap-south
audit-bot: Note: rotation job audit event recorded (job_id=rot-20260321-0710). RBAC principals: cert-rotator-sa granted secretsmanager:PutSecret this morning.
irfan (infra): Two parallel things to check: 1) Are we seeing KMS Decrypt denies in eu-west2 for any keystore reads? 2) Can we permit a short-term RSA-suite fallback on the edge LB for ap-south only and monitor?
natalie (sec-eng): I saw a KMS error earlier for a different service in eu-west2: `AccessDeniedException: User: arn:aws:sts::...:assumed-role/edge-role is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on key arn:...` — That was at 07:12 UTC, right after rotation. Might be the rotator changed key alias binding?
sean (edge): If the rotator rekeyed and we haven't propagated IAM policy for the new key ARN, decrypt will fail for hot reloads. For immediate mitigation I can add a region-scoped TLS policy: enable TLS1.2+RSA fallback only for client IPs flagged by proxy logs. Low-risk if short-lived.
irfan (infra): Agreed. Also file an IAM ticket to add the new key ARN to the edge-role's kms:Decrypt allow list — include condition aws:RequestedRegion for eu-west-2 to limit blast radius.
natalie (sec-eng): Proposed steps: 
- short-term: enable RSA-AES-CBC fallback for ap-south edge LB (canary 10% traffic -> 100% if stable)
- immediate: add kms:Decrypt permission for new-key-arn to edge-role (eu-west-2)
- medium: revert cipher removal from global config and re-run a staged rollout with canaries across regions
- long-term: add telemetry to identify clients using legacy ciphers and create a migration plan (contact customers)
sean (edge): I'll push a canary config now. Nginx snippet to toggle: 
```
# canary ap-south
server {
  listen 443 ssl;
  ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;
  ssl_ciphers "ECDHE+AESGCM:ECDHE+CHACHA20:RSA+AES:!aNULL:!MD5"; # temp fallback includes RSA
  ssl_prefer_server_ciphers on;
}
```
opsbot: canary deploy started (deploy_id=canary-5112345678-1). Rolling 10% edge-ap-south backends.
natalie (sec-eng): Also: we observed a noisy CVE alert yesterday for OpenSSL on the legacy client library (CVE-2026-9999). Not related to server hardening but callout to product teams if they surface older clients.
irfan (infra): I'm opening an IAM change PR now and tagging @sec-eng for review. Will include cloudtrail link and explicit policy diff.
sean (edge): Canary showing reduced handshake errors for those test IPs. Monitoring for 30m then scale.
opsbot: monitor:tls-handshake-errors-ap-south triggered (threshold crossed) — suppressed due to canary rollout.
audit-bot: Logged manual RBAC approval comment: "edge-role kms:Decrypt allow for new-key-arn (eu-west-2) — approved by irfan".
natalie (sec-eng): After canary succeeds, schedule a customer notice for legacy clients and open a runbook to avoid full global cipher toggles mid-rotation. Also add a step in rotation job to validate per-region keystore IAM bindings before switching certs.
sean (edge): Agreed. I'll keep the temporary fallback for 2 hours max unless we see more anomalies.
irfan (infra): PR submitted: https://git.internal.redwood/infra/iam/pull/432 — includes least-priv kms:Decrypt with region condition.
natalie (sec-eng): Thanks. Closing the immediate loop — will follow up with a postmortem if we need it. :white_check_mark:
